method: Retrospective review performed by the implementation-session agent; committed Git diff inspected directly.

detector.scope: Committed trees only; local edits are excluded. Changed paths are review candidates, not architectural conclusions.

dispositions.reason: Lockfile updates version, resolution and integrity for the same dependency. The diff adds no new dependency edge.
Only the existing obsidian-eval dependency version changes from 0.6.1 to 0.6.2; no new component, responsibility or integration is declared.

limits: This conclusion applies to repository architecture. Internal behavior of the external package was not evaluated.
The eight-component map was authored at the target commit; the detector was exercised retrospectively using the preceding commit. This is not an autonomous host-run evaluation.
